dedupe_keys.name: referenser och testdataset for cactus rorledningen

description: Referenser och testdataset för Cactus-rörledningen is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Karolinska Institutet. Overview This item contains references and test datasets for the Cactus pipeline. Cactus (Chromatin ACcessibility and Transcriptomics Unification Software) is an mRNA-Seq and ATAC-Seq analysis pipeline that aims to provide advanced molecular insights on the conditions under study. Coverage: Karolinska Institutet. The portal shows the English title as "References and test datasets for the Cactus pipeline" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Karolinska Institutet. Its keywords include Genomics and transcriptomics, Bioinformatic methods development. The listing shows 2023-05-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
